name: obb-ablation-matrix
train_command: from ultralytics import YOLO; import json, os; model = YOLO('{model}'); results = model.train(data='{data}', epochs={epochs}, batch={batch}, imgsz=640, device=0, workers=4, project='{output_parent}', name='{trial_name}', exist_ok=True, patience=20, save=True, save_period=10, val=True); rd = results.results_dict; metrics = {{'name': '{trial_name}', 'epochs': {epochs}, 'batch': {batch}, 'mAP50': float(rd.get('metrics/mAP50(B)', 0)), 'mAP50_95': float(rd.get('metrics/mAP50-95(B)', 0))}}; os.makedirs('{output_parent}/results', exist_ok=True); json.dump(metrics, open('{output_parent}/results/{trial_name}.json', 'w'), indent=2); print(json.dumps(metrics, indent=2))
